frontmatter.title: AI Agents vs AI Pipelines: An Architectural Trade-off, Not a Trend
frontmatter.subheading: Understanding control flow, feedback loops, and failure modes
frontmatter.excerpt: AI agents are not a silver bullet. This post compares AI pipelines and agent-based systems through an architectural lens, focusing on control flow, failure modes, and long-term maintainability.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
